pickChannel: Pick a Channel to send the "Start Ticket" Message in
initDesc: Click the Button below to create a Ticket
editSteps:
1. Copy the Message URL of the "Start Ticket" Message
2. Enter the `/embed-builder create` Command and press `Start Over`
3. Create your desired Embed
4. Once done, press the `Edit` Button and paste the Message Link into the shown Text field
notActive: Ticketing-System not found or not disabled
startChatting:
Please explain why you opened this Ticket. The Ticket-Team will reply shortly.
-# Every following message will be relayed to the Support-Team until the Ticket is closed or you left it
openDMs: Failed to send DM. Please open your DMs in the Servers Privacy Settings.
staffIntro: Private staff-only discussion for this Ticket. Nothing here is relayed to the Ticket creator, but every message is logged internally and added to the transcript.
blocked: You are blocked from creating Tickets
messageFailedDeliver: Failed to deliver the Message. Recipient might have closed their DMs
leaveSure: Are you sure you want to leave the Ticket? You will not be able to rejoin it.
alreadyInTicket:
You already are in a Ticket. Please leave it first via the `Leave Ticket` button.
The Message with the Button is Pinned to our DMs
ticketLeft: User left the Ticket. Messages sent will no longer be relayed
leftTicket: Left Ticket. Messages will no longer be delivered.
reportAbuse: Please report abuse to the Ayako Support-Team
hasClosedThreadRelay: Closed the Ticket. Messages will no longer be relayed
hasClosedThreadInactiveRelay: Closed the Ticket due to inactivity. Messages will no longer be relayed
hasClosedThreadInactive: Closed the Ticket due to inactivity
cantOpenDMs: Failed to open DMs. Please check your privacy settings.
onlyStaffCanClose: Only the Support-Team can close Tickets
onlyStaffCanDelete: Only the Support-Team can delete Tickets
couldntSendDm: Couldn't send a DM to the user
couldntEditDm: Couldn't edit the DM to the user

logs.logExplain: Use a prefix to reply to the ticket creator. Messages without a prefix are staff-only.
logs.logExplainAll: All messages here are sent to the ticket creator. Add reply prefixes in settings to change this.
logs.nameGuard: I rely on this thread's name to route ticket messages, so I reverted the rename. You can rename it freely once the ticket is deleted — use the delete button that appears after closing the ticket.
logs.descDeletedUnusual:
> -# The ticket channel {{channel}} was deleted outside the bot.
> -# A transcript was salvaged from the message cache.
